title: SSC CGL Tier 1 — Free Mock Test 1

questions.q: Find the next number in the series: 3, 7, 15, 31, 63, ?
questions.explanation: Each term = previous × 2 + 1. 63×2+1 = 127.

questions.q: Pointing to a photograph, a man says, 'I am the only son of this man's father.' How is the man related to the person in the photograph?
questions.explanation: If he is the only son of the photo's father, the photo is his father.

questions.q: Select the odd one out: Triangle, Square, Circle, Hexagon, Sphere
questions.explanation: All others are 2D shapes; Sphere is a 3D shape.

questions.q: If A=1, B=2, C=3... Z=26, what is the sum of letters in 'CAT'?
Arrange in logical order: 1) Marriage 2) Engagement 3) Courtship 4) Birth 5) Death
questions.explanation: Birth → Courtship → Engagement → Marriage → Death is the typical life sequence.

questions.q: Which word does NOT belong with the others?
questions.explanation: Inch, Yard and Mile measure length; Quart measures volume.

questions.q: If 'PAPER' is coded as 'QBQFS', how is 'PEN' coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by one position in the alphabet.

questions.q: Who is the current Chief Election Commissioner of India (as of 2026)?
questions.explanation: Gyanesh Kumar took over as CEC after Rajiv Kumar's retirement. Verify current status before publishing as this changes periodically.

questions.q: The Tropic of Cancer passes through how many Indian states?
questions.explanation: It passes through 8 states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, Mizoram.

questions.q: Which Article of the Indian Constitution deals with the Right to Equality?
questions.explanation: Article 14 guarantees equality before law.

questions.q: The Khilji dynasty ruled Delhi between which years (approx.)?
questions.explanation: The Khilji dynasty ruled from 1290 to 1320 CE.

questions.q: Which is the longest river in India?
questions.explanation: The Ganga is the longest river flowing entirely within India (~2525 km).

questions.q: The 'Green Revolution' in India is primarily associated with which crop?
questions.explanation: The Green Revolution focused mainly on high-yield wheat and rice varieties, starting with wheat in Punjab.

questions.q: Who composed the national song 'Vande Mataram'?
questions.explanation: Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay wrote Vande Mataram, included in his novel Anandamath.

questions.q: If the cost price of an article is ₹450 and it is sold at a profit of 20%, what is the selling price?
A train 200 m long crosses a pole in 10 seconds. What is its speed in km/h?
The average of 5 consecutive even numbers is 26. What is the largest number?
questions.explanation: Numbers: 22,24,26,28,30 — average = 26, largest = 30.

questions.q: A sum of money becomes ₹1,200 in 2 years and ₹1,400 in 4 years at simple interest. Find the principal.
questions.explanation: SI for 2 years = 200, so annual interest = 100. Principal = 1200 - 2×100 = ₹1000.

questions.q: If sin θ = 3/5, what is cos θ (θ acute)?
questions.explanation: Using Pythagorean identity: cos θ = √(1 − 9/25) = √(16/25) = 4/5.

questions.q: What is 15% of 240?
Choose the correctly spelled word.
questions.explanation: 'Accommodate' has double 'c' and double 'm'.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: She has been working here ___ 2019.
questions.explanation: 'Since' is used with a specific point in time (a year).

questions.q: Choose the antonym of 'Benevolent'.
questions.explanation: 'Malevolent' means having ill will, the opposite of benevolent.

questions.q: Identify the correctly punctuated sentence.
options: Although he was tired, he finished the work.
Although he was tired he finished the work
Although, he was tired, he finished the work.
Although he was tired he, finished the work.
questions.explanation: A comma is needed after the introductory subordinate clause.
